Its defensibility spec named the one acquisition that could close that gap — the Lập thành section of this book — and recorded it as not held. It is now held and this pack is that section. Every rule quotes the Vietnamese verbatim as the publisher's text layer reads it, with an engine_rendering graded engine_translation_unreviewed beside it and the printed page number cited; where a printed grid is flattened by the text layer the PDF page was rendered at 170 dpi and the table read from the page image, which is stated in the verification field of every passage. scope.work: Tử Vi đẩu số tân biên
scope.technique: định cung — the fixed twelve-branch board

conclusion.vietnamese: Mỗi ô là một cung. Bắt đầu từ một là cung thứ nhất, gọi là cung Tý, đếm theo chiều thuận (thuận chiều kim đồng hồ) lần lượt Tý, Sửu, Dần, Mão, Thìn, Tỵ, Ngọ, Mùi, Thân, Dậu, Tuất, Hợi. Mỗi chữ trên đây là tên riêng của một cung, 12 chữ này gọi là Thập Nhị Địa Chi. Vị trí và tên của mỗi cung ở trên bản đồ không bao giờ thay đổi.
conclusion.engine_rendering: Each cell is a palace. Beginning from the first, called the palace Tý, count in the forward direction (clockwise) in turn Tý, Sửu, Dần, Mão, Thìn, Tỵ, Ngọ, Mùi, Thân, Dậu, Tuất, Hợi. Each of these words is the proper name of a palace, and the twelve are called the Twelve Earthly Branches. The position and the name of each palace on the board never change.

centre.engine_rendering: The empty space in the middle of the board is the Thiên bàn palace, where the year, month, day and hour of birth are written.

scope.technique: định giờ — converting clock time to the branch hour

conclusion.vietnamese: Lập thành một lá số, điều quan trọng nhất là phải định đúng giờ sinh. Phải đổi giờ đồng hồ ra giờ hàng Chi. Một ngày có 24 giờ đồng hồ. Hai giờ đồng hồ bằng một giờ hàng Chi.
conclusion.engine_rendering: In setting up a chart the most important thing is to fix the hour of birth correctly. The clock hour must be converted into the branch hour. A day has 24 clock hours. Two clock hours make one branch hour.
conclusion.undisclosed_by_the_source: The book gives no rule for which clock — local mean time, zone time, or a war-time offset — and Vietnam changed its civil offset repeatedly in the twentieth century. Any engine applying this table must name the clock it used.

exceptions: The Tý hour straddles midnight, so a birth between 23:00 and 24:00 falls in the Tý hour of the following day by this table; the book does not say whether the calendar day advances with it, and this pack does not decide the question.

scope.work: Tử Vi đẩu số tân biên
scope.technique: collation of the five printed Tử Vi tables against a closed form

conclusion.finding: Of the 150 printed day-entries across the five cục tables, 148 agree exactly with a single closed-form placement. The two failures are in Kim tứ cục alone: the day 21 appears twice (at Mùi and at Thìn) and the day 24 appears nowhere. The closed form assigns 21 to Thìn and 24 to Mùi, so the printed Mùi cell '14 - 21 - 27' should read '14 - 24 - 27'.
conclusion.closed_form: Let n be the cục number and d the lunar day. Put q = ceil(d/n) and m = q*n - d. Count q-1 palaces forward from Dần; then move m palaces forward if m is even, or m palaces backward if m is odd.
conclusion.closed_form_status: configured_method — the closed form is the ENGINE'S reconstruction. The book prints tables and never states a formula. The reconstruction is offered as a collation instrument, not as the source's doctrine, and the tables remain the authority.
conclusion.policy: The pack does NOT emend the printed table. The printed reading is kept, the defect is recorded, and the correction the closed form predicts is stated as a prediction — the same discipline the Sukuyōdō pack applies to its two corrupt 羅剎日 graphs and the Vietnamese Lê Quí Đôn pack applies to its unreadable photographic tail.

scope.work: Tử Vi đẩu số tân biên
scope.technique: khởi đại hạn — the ten-year period, with the book's two methods and its own preference

method_1.vietnamese: Bắt đầu ghi số Cục ở cung an Mệnh, đoạn dương nam, âm nữ theo chiều thuận, âm nam, dương nữ theo chiều nghịch, lần lượt ghi số tiếp theo, từ cung này chuyển sang cung khác phải cộng thêm mười.
method_1.engine_rendering: Begin by writing the cục number at the palace of Mệnh; then a dương nam or âm nữ goes forward and an âm nam or dương nữ goes backward, writing the following numbers in turn, adding ten at each move from one palace to the next.

method_1_example.vietnamese: Thí dụ: Dương nam, Hỏa lục cục, bắt đầu ghi số 6 ở cung Mệnh, rồi ghi số 16 ở cung Phụ Mẫu, 26 ở cung Phúc Đức...
method_1_example.engine_rendering: Example: a dương nam with Hỏa lục cục begins by writing 6 at the palace of Mệnh, then 16 at Phụ Mẫu, 26 at Phúc Đức...

method_2.vietnamese: Không ghi số Cục ở cung an Mệnh, dương nam, âm nữ theo chiều thuận, ghi liên tiếp … âm nam, dương nữ theo chiều nghịch, ghi số Cục ở cung Huynh Đệ, đoạn ghi liên tiếp…
method_2.engine_rendering: Do not write the cục number at the palace of Mệnh; a dương nam or âm nữ goes forward writing successively … an âm nam or dương nữ goes backward, writing the cục number at the palace of Huynh Đệ and then successively on…

the_books_own_choice.vietnamese: Đây là hai cách khởi đại hạn. Nhưng thường người ta hay dùng cách thứ nhất vì nó chính xác hơn.
the_books_own_choice.engine_rendering: These are the two ways of starting the đại hạn. But people usually use the first, because it is more accurate.

conclusion.policy: The book states a preference and does not suppress the alternative, so neither does this pack. Method 1 is marked preferred BY THE SOURCE, which is a different thing from being chosen by the product.

reading_rule.vietnamese: Một cung đã được ghi đại hạn, tức là vận hạn trong mười năm phải được xem trong cung đó.
reading_rule.engine_rendering: Once a palace carries a đại hạn number, the fortunes of that ten-year span must be read in that palace.

conclusion.divergence_note: Method 1's own example steps from Mệnh to PHỤ MẪU going forward. Under the Chinese enumeration the palace forward of Mệnh is Huynh Đệ. This is the palace-order reversal showing up inside the timing system, which is where a wrongly borrowed enumeration would do the most damage.

scope.technique: lưu đại hạn, lưu niên tiểu hạn, lưu nguyệt, lưu nhật, lưu thời — the finer timing ladders

luu_dai_han.vietnamese: Cung đã ghi đại hạn, gọi là cung gốc của đại hạn mười năm. Muốn xem vận hạn tường tận hơn, phải lưu đại hạn hàng năm.
luu_dai_han.engine_rendering: The palace carrying a đại hạn is called the root palace of that ten-year span. To read the fortunes in finer detail the đại hạn must be run year by year.

tieu_han_direction.vietnamese: Nam khởi lưu theo chiều thuận. Nữ khởi lưu theo chiều nghịch.
tieu_han_direction.engine_rendering: A man's annual count runs forward. A woman's runs backward.

conclusion.tieu_han_direction_note: This is the ONE rule in Lập thành that turns on sex alone rather than on the yin/yang class. Every other directional rule in the chapter reads 'dương nam, âm nữ' against 'âm nam, dương nữ'. The pack records the difference and does not harmonise it.
luu_nguyet_three_methods: from the tiểu hạn palace as the first month, count BACKWARD to the birth month; call that palace the hour Tý and count forward to the birth hour; call that palace the first month and run forward
from the tiểu hạn palace as the first month, count FORWARD to the birth month; call that palace the hour Tý and count forward to the birth hour; call that palace the first month and run forward
from the tiểu hạn palace as the first month, simply run forward one palace per month

luu_nguyet_the_books_own_position.vietnamese: Trên đây là khởi lưu nguyệt hạn. Nhưng thường người ta hay dùng cách thứ nhất. Biên giả mong các vị nghiên cứu Tử Vi đẩu số thử nghiệm cả ba cách để xem cách nào chính xác hơn.
luu_nguyet_the_books_own_position.engine_rendering: Those are the ways of starting the monthly period. But people usually use the first. The compiler hopes that students of Tử Vi đẩu số will test all three to see which is the more accurate.

conclusion.luu_nhat: from the monthly palace as the first day of the month, one palace per day, forward
conclusion.luu_thoi: from the daily palace as the hour Tý, one palace per branch hour, forward
conclusion.fork_policy: Three methods for the month are printed, the author states a usage preference and then explicitly declines to settle the question, asking his readers to test all three. That is an unusually clean case of a source leaving a fork open, and the pack leaves it open.

scope.technique: the order in which a chart must be built, as the book's own dependencies impose it

stages: tìm bản Mệnh (nạp âm of the year pillar)

conclusion.how_it_is_established: The book numbers its sections 1 to 11 and each numbered star group in section 8 in turn, but the binding order is not the numbering — it is the dependency graph the instructions create. Lập cục needs the palace of Mệnh; the Tử Vi seat needs the cục; Thiên Phủ needs Tử Vi; Tam Thai and Bát Tọa need Tả Phụ and Hữu Bật; Ân Quang and Thiên Quý need Văn Xương and Văn Khúc; Kình Dương, Đà La, Quốc Ấn, Đường Phù and Bác Sỹ need Lộc Tồn; Thiên Không needs Thái Tuế; Thiên Tài and Thiên Thọ need Mệnh and Thân; Tứ Hóa needs every carrier star already seated; and the đại hạn needs both the cục and the palace enumeration.
conclusion.consequence: Any engine that runs these rules in the printed section order rather than in dependency order will attempt to seat Tứ Hóa before its carriers exist.

scope.work: Tử Vi đẩu số tân biên
scope.technique: what in this witness is Vietnamese practice and what is inherited Chinese doctrine

the_authors_own_statement.vietnamese: Môn cổ học này do một nhà Lý học uyên thâm đời Tống là Trần Đoàn tức là Hi Di Tử lập ra. Sau lại được nhiều nhà Lý học khác bổ sung, diễn dịch, triển khai và xếp đặt thành một môn học có hệ thống rành mạch. Ở nước ta, từ xưa đến nay, đã có nhiều người nghiên cứu Tử Vi đẩu số. Nhưng mỗi người hiểu một cách khác.
the_authors_own_statement.engine_rendering: This old science was founded by a profound Song-dynasty scholar of principle, Trần Đoàn, that is Hi Di Tử. Later many other scholars supplemented, interpreted, developed and arranged it into a clearly systematic study. In our country, from of old until now, many people have studied Tử Vi đẩu số. But each understands it differently.

conclusion.what_this_settles: The book is explicit that the system descends from Chen Tuan and equally explicit that Vietnamese readings of it disagree among themselves. It therefore supports neither of the two errors the track guards against: it is not a translation of the Quanshu, and it is not an independent invention.
vietnamese_distinctive_in_this_witness: the palace enumeration reversed against the Chinese order, stated as a construction instruction and confirmed by the đại hạn worked example
Vietnamese star nomenclature throughout, with no Chinese characters anywhere in the chapter
Tuần and Triệt given full placement tables and board diagrams as first-class agents
the author's own admission of disagreement among Vietnamese readers, and his invitation to test the three lưu nguyệt methods empirically
shared_with_the_chinese_tradition: the twelve-branch board and the counting idioms
the five cục and the Tử Vi day tables
the tam hợp / xung / nhị hợp aspect frame
conclusion.not_established: Whether any of the shared items agrees CELL BY CELL with the 紫微斗數全書 is not established here, because no Quanshu edition is pinned in this repository. Until one is, this pack labels the shared items 'shared with the Chinese tradition' and not 'identical to it'.
conclusion.standing_refusal: No rule from this pack may be relabelled Chinese, and no rule from ziwei/ may be relabelled Vietnamese. The tracks share no source, no rule and no vector.
